definitions.accepted_detector_labels: TP or FP decisions with named acceptance; a separate evidence tier from recorded opinions.
definitions.human_review_actions: Recorded human response units; repeats across people and passes are work, not unique events.
definitions.lead_reviewed_candidate_window_minutes: Union of source-time windows with complete lead span answers; selected windows only, not whole-session annotation.
definitions.recorded_session_minutes: Evidence-eligible source recording runtime; clips and renders are not added.
definitions.scope: Activity inventory, including diagnostic review; no precision, recall, accuracy, or safety claim. Drafts, fixtures and superseded unissued work are excluded from review-action counters.
definitions.sessions_with_recorded_review: Distinct evidence-eligible source sessions with at least one recorded human review action or complete lead candidate-window answer.
definitions.unique_detector_fires_with_verdict: Distinct detector-fire subjects with any recorded human verdict; repeated reviews count once.
